title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 65

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 65
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 65
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATORS
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 16th April 1979]
No. 65
1. This Martial Law Order shall come into force at
once.
2. In Martial Law Order No. 17, hereinafter referred
to as the said Order, in paragraph 1, in sub-paragraph (2), in clause (a), the
following proviso shall be inserted, namely-
"Provided that the Chief Martial Law
Administrator may, while authoris ing a Martial Law Administrator or any other
officer or authority to exercise the powers of "Competent Authority",
restrict the exercise of such powers to such extent as he may deem fit".
3. In the said Order, in paragraph 9, for
sub-paragraph (3), the follow ing shall be substituted, namely-
"(3) Notwithstanding anything contained in the
terms and conditions of service of the person against whom action is proposed
to be taken under this Order the competent authority may-
(a) after examining the report of the Inquiry
Officer, and after informing him of the reasons therefore and giving him an
opportunity to show cause in writing within a period of seven days as to why
action should not be taken against him; or
(b) where the competent authority decides not to have
an inquiry conducted, after examining the explanation of the person, if any,
received in reply to the notice given under the first proviso to sub-paragraph
(t) of paragraph 2; by order in the official Gazette, dismiss or remove such
person from service, or reduce him in rank, or direct that he shall prematurely
be retired from service and may, in addition to any of the aforesaid actions
also refer his case to any ordinary Criminal Court, or a Military Court, as the
case may be, for trial.
4. In the said Order, in paragraph 11 after
sub-paragraph (2), the following new sub-paragraph shall be added namely :-
"(3) If a person is dismissed removed from the
service or reduced in rank or ordered to be prematurely retired from service
under the provisions of this order by competent authority. other than the Chief
Martial Law Adminis trator, and in respect of whom an inquiry was dispensed
with under proviso to sub-paragraph (1) of paragraph (2), may, if he considers
himself aggrieved by the order passed on his review petition by competent
authority concerned, submit a petition to the Chief Martial Law Administrator
against such order within 30 days of the receipt of the order and the Chief
Martial Law Administrator on considering the petition may pass such order as he
deems fit under ft circumstances of the case".
